Step 6b is complete for batches 4, 5 and 6. Report: `research/frontier-15-alpha-b-6b.md`.

## One blocker — the refuter lane never ran

The brief requires read-only proof-refuters (GPT 5.6 Sol) before adjudication. I wrote eight task files partitioning all 113 items and dispatched them; every one failed with `You've hit your usage limit … try again at Aug 20th, 2026 1:32 PM`. Group `c`'s eight refuters finished just before mine and consumed the remaining Codex quota. The reset is three days out, so this is not a wait-and-retry.

The model lineup is binding, so I did **not** re-route refuters to another family. I did the adversarial reading myself against those eight checklists — all 52 high/critical items in full, every cited dependency opened, every example recomputed by hand. What is lost is the independence of the evidence, not the reading. Batch 7 got eight refuters; batches 4–6 got none. The task files are ready to dispatch after Aug 20.

## Adjudication

All 30 reader findings adjudicated from disk: **14 confirmed fatal** (all repairs re-derived and accepted), 11 confirmed nonfatal, 5 polish. Nothing was taken on trust — e.g. I re-instantiated the repaired transfinite recursion at the empty generator, re-expanded all twelve directed edges of the Goursat subdivision lemma, and recomputed every example's arithmetic.

Two defects the readers missed, both repaired:

- **`thm-dynkin-pi-lambda`** — `[L1]`/`[L2]` said "finite intersections" where both sources say "binary". Nonfatal (the deviations cancelled) but repaired now, because it's exactly what step-7 judges read. `citation-fidelity` stayed green because it compares the *contract quote* to the source, never the item's `[L#]` prose to the quote — **the same gap is behind five of the run's confirmed fatals in my batches.**
- **`fs-every-subset-of-r-is-borel`** — the refutation used `𝔠 = |ℝ|` with no cited home; without it the argument yields no contradiction. My first repair cited `ex-the-cardinality-of-the-continuum` and `depcheck` rejected it (`b-leaf-content`) — that gate forced the honest route. Re-routed through the Cantor set via two A-page results; proof, manifest, contract and boundary anchors updated together.

The load-bearing chains hold. Goursat → primitive → Cauchy → CIF → higher derivatives: the `4ⁿ` cancels exactly, the exceptional-point theorem uses only continuity at `p` (not circular), and the star-shaped primitive genuinely needs only star-shapedness. The `π₁(S¹) ≅ ℤ` chain imports path and homotopy lifting from published items, none restated more widely than proved.

## Deliverables

52 `risk_review` dispositions (`--require-reviewed`: 0 errors, all three batches); 41 ledger rows (`validate`: 60 frontier-15 rows, 0 errors); all batch gates green; `precheck` 4264/0 repo-wide.

Honest gaps: **`finite-smoke` passes vacuously** on all three batches (0 checks over 0 items — a recorded non-run, not evidence); harvest faithfulness is spot-checked, not exhaustive, for eight of nine sources — though I did verify Marker's Corollary 2.38 by extracting the PDF text, confirming R4-6's repair; one source URL fails (archive 503 + host timeout, which is not enough evidence to re-source under RECOVER BEFORE REPLACE — left open for a pre-publish re-sweep).
